education.degree: Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science

dissertation.title: Distance-Aware Real-Time Assistive Navigation System Using YOLOv8 and Monocular Depth Estimation
dissertation.description: Developed a spatial guidance framework combining YOLOv8 real-time object detection with monocular geometric depth estimation to provide directional awareness (left/center/right) for visually impaired users. Implemented scalable FastAPI microservices and multilingual audio feedback.
